comparison.objective: Fit matching caps to four pens and sort the capped pens by color.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated cap-to-pen alignment and insertion, visual matching, placement, and release.
comparison.success_condition: Four matching caps retained and four pens released, stable, and fully inside the correct marked areas.
comparison.reason: This is repeated press-fit assembly plus sorting. It contains neither impact-controlled fracture nor protection of a retained coil or recovery of fractured metal fragments.
